card.name: Environment variable descriptions in manuals
card.fires_on: Words in technical manual text about variables and settings, such as 'been' after 'had', 'TZ' or 'variables' in environment-variable passages. It also fires on a few scattered words with no link.

modes.label: Environment variable text
modes.description: Words naming or describing environment variables in Unix manual pages, such as TZ and variables.
modes.example: The job will be submitted for execution at the time specified by timespec or -t time relative to the timezone specified by the<< TZ>> variable.

modes.label: Conditional wording about variables
modes.description: Verbs or linking words in if-unset or invalid-setting clauses.
modes.example: If any of the internationalisation variables contains an invalid setting, the utility will behave as if none of the variables had<< been>> defined.
